source_note: Names, descriptions, grades and hidden status are the official PlayStation trophy list, as published and listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (the two listings agree on every entry). Guides, kinds, roadmap stages and watch flags are this app's own work, written from those descriptions.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum: earn all 54 other trophies and this one is awarded on its own. Treat it as the finish line of the checklist below — the roadmap is ordered to reach it without backtracking.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: A story mission. Play Gone Fishing through as it arrives in the campaign; the trophy lands on completion, with no score or style target attached.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1 of the story. Pure progression — finish the chapter's missions and it pops at the chapter break.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Same shape as Chapter 1: work the chapter's missions to the break and the trophy follows.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Progression only; nothing in the description asks for more than finishing the chapter.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Keep a manual save before the chapter's last mission if you are also chasing the one-time feats flagged in this guide.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the campaign's final mission. Before you start it, save manually and finish any mission-tied one-time feats (see Catch Me If You Can and the two watch-flagged choices) — the endgame is the wrong time to discover them.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: A story mission. Complete Breakfast Run as it comes; completion alone earns it.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist mission. Heists usually offer an approach choice; the description rewards completion, so either route earns it.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: A story mission. Complete Child's Play as it arrives in the campaign.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: A story mission. Complete Headliners as it arrives in the campaign.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the VCIA Takedown mission — and read Catch Me If You Can before you do: that feat is set at the same airport and is easiest while this mission puts you there.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: A story mission. Complete Operation Savage Glory as it arrives in the campaign.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the game's own completion counter. It is the sum of this whole list plus the game's side content; use the in-game percentage as the checklist of record and mop up by category at the end.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunt events. They are repeatable and scattered state-wide; chain them while travelling between other objectives instead of grinding them in one sitting, and re-run the short ones near your garage.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every type of activity once — one attempt each, win or lose. Note the types off as you meet them; the last one is usually a niche activity found away from the story path.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge. Learn one weapon class at a time; accuracy beats speed on the medal thresholds, and challenges can be retried on the spot.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location. One win per location is enough — move on and clear the map pin by pin.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Different means different events, not the same race twenty times; work across vehicle classes as they unlock.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal belongs to the story's fishing strand; take the challenge when it is offered and land the target catch first.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — a single full play at any arcade cabinet. The quickest cabinet you find is the right one.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand: take his jobs whenever they appear and complete the strand's final mission.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand the same way: work his jobs as they surface and complete the final one.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand: take the jobs in order and complete the strand's final mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Strands are the chance encounters the map offers; finish a strand's whole chain, not just its opener, and keep count — eight full strands, any eight.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand: work his jobs whenever they appear and complete the final mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand: take his jobs in order and complete the strand's final mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot in Leonida. The spots are fixed locations; treat them as a collectible route and clear them region by region while doing other map work.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret is a hunting contact; work his strand until he asks for the unique animal, then track and take it as the hunt directs.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets. Cards are found across the state; finish sets rather than spreading thin — the trophy counts completed sets, so focus one set's locations at a time.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. The locations are service points spread over the map; make a habit of stopping whenever one is nearby instead of farming them all at the end.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the short scored tasks the world offers; they accumulate naturally if you accept them as they appear — check your count before the endgame mop-up.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner, gain a 4-star Wanted level, then lose it and escape together. Do it deliberately: raise the level somewhere with an easy escape route, and stay together until the heat is gone.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner while keeping the Wanted level up the whole time. Pick three shops close together, move fast between them, and do not let the level drop until the third is done.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — meeting a vehicle model for the first time counts it. Varied traffic in different districts makes this mostly a matter of time; take what you find rather than driving favourites.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Set it up: start a fight with at least five enemies in the open, trigger Combat Focus once, and drop five before it ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — the airport. It is easiest during the VCIA Takedown mission, when you are already there with a reason to fly out: take a plane and leave instead of following the script. Flagged as one to watch because the chance may not come back once that mission is over.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is the game's joke about the Rhino tank being hot inside: the feat is tied to the Rhino itself. Get into one — military hardware, so expect a military response or a base — and make the mayhem the tank is for.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: no alarms, no witness calling it in, and out before anyone knows. If a run is spotted, leave and try another store rather than forcing it.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Plan the exit before you start, and count escapes, not just robberies — a bust mid-job does not advance it.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The trucks appear on the road; stop one, take the cash, and lose the response. One clean job earns it.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — uncover the whole map. What counts is visiting every area; a long drive or flight around the state's edges and islands at the mop-up stage finishes what the story missed.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang. One per gang, so first learn which operations belong to whom; the map work for other trophies surfaces most of them.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: A quiet one: go to Ocean Beach, have the cocktail where drinks are sold on the strip, and take in the view — the description is the whole recipe.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom: take a car from inside one and drive it out through the glass. Pick a showroom where you can reach a car and hit a window at speed.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl — the 'follow-through' is a bowler's motion, so play the game there as the name puns.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The list describes this one only as 'a partnership with mass appeal' — a partner feat. Work it alongside the other two-player trophies, Hot Together and Retail Therapy, with your partner; it belongs to the partnership content.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Described as 'Choices made (for better or worse)' — it is tied to a choice the story offers. A choice cannot be unmade on the same save, so keep a manual save before big story decisions; if the trophy does not land, the other branch is the likely trigger. Flagged from its description.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Described as 'Second time's the charm' — it is tied to missing or failing once and succeeding on a second attempt. If a one-chance event goes wrong, do not reload at once: play on and take the second chance the game offers. Flagged from its description.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Described only as 'What the hell just happened?' — the list's UFO-flavoured oddity. Leonida hides a strange encounter; when something impossible happens out in the wilds, stay and see it through instead of driving away.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by: from a moving vehicle, melee-hit people as you pass — the pins are pedestrians and the ball is the car. A slow pass along a busy pavement with the melee ready is the shape of it.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from scores; route them through contacts whenever you hold them instead of spending them clean, and the laundered total builds.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — lifetime spending, every shop combined. It accrues on its own as you buy vehicles, clothes and services; check the gap before the endgame property purchases.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase every garage property on sale. Garages are bought through the property market; this is an endgame purchase, once the money trophies have filled the account.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. When you take a vehicle you want to keep, register it in the app; ten registrations, any ten vehicles.
